title: Immigration Adviser Manchester | Visa Services | UVS
description: IAA-regulated immigration and visa advice in Manchester city centre since 2008. Spouse visas, Skilled Worker, ILR, citizenship, sponsor licences and travel visas.
h1: Immigration advice and visa services in Manchester
intro: We’re an IAA-regulated immigration and visa practice at 61 Mosley Street in Manchester city centre. Come in and meet an adviser, or work with us by phone, video call or WhatsApp.

sections.heading: Our Manchester office
sections.text:
Our office is at Suite 6, 61 Mosley Street, Manchester M2 3HZ, a few minutes’ walk from Piccadilly Gardens and St Peter’s Square. We’ve worked from Manchester since 2008, helping individuals, families and employers across the North West.

Please call or email before you visit so an adviser is free to see you. You can bring your documents in, and we’ll go through them with you there and then. If it’s easier, most cases can be handled entirely by phone, video call and email.

sections.heading: UK immigration help for Manchester clients
sections.text:
Most of our Manchester clients come to us for:
- [Spouse and partner visas](/uk-spouse-visas/), including first applications and extensions
- [Skilled Worker visas](/skilled-worker-visa-formally-tier-t2-general/) for people taking a job in the UK
- [Indefinite Leave to Remain](/indefinite-leave-to-remain-ilr/) and [British citizenship](/british-citizenship/)
- [Student visas](/student-visa-uk/) and [visit visas](/uk-visit-visa/) for family members

We tell you honestly whether you qualify before you pay, agree our fee in writing, and check every document against the current rules before anything is submitted.

sections.heading: Your biometrics appointment
sections.text:
For most applications made inside the UK, you book an appointment at a UK Visa and Citizenship Application Service (UKVCAS) point after applying online, to give your fingerprints and photo and have your documents checked. Greater Manchester is served by a main service point, so most of our clients don’t need to travel far.

We tell you which appointment to book, and make sure your documents are ready and in the right order before you go. Many routes now let you prove your identity with the UK Immigration: ID Check app instead, and we’ll tell you if that applies to you.

sections.heading: Chinese visas from Manchester
sections.text:
The Chinese Visa Application Service Centre in Manchester moved to Ground Floor, 7 Charlotte Street, Manchester M1 4DZ in October 2026. It handles applications from across the North of England.

British passport holders can currently visit China without a visa for up to 30 days, until 31 December 2026. Longer stays, and work, study and many business trips, still need a visa. We prepare your online application and documents, and our office is a short walk from the centre. See our [China visa service](/china-visa-application/), [China business visa](/china-business-visa/) and [China work visa](/china-work-visa-for-uk-citizens/) pages.

sections.heading: Employers in Manchester and the North West
sections.text:
We help Manchester businesses hire from overseas, from first [sponsor licence applications](/sponsor-licence-application/) to keeping on top of [sponsor duties and compliance](/sponsor-licence-compliance/). We regularly work with [care homes](/sponsor-licence-care-homes/), [restaurants](/sponsor-licence-restaurants/), [IT and technology firms](/sponsor-licence-it-technology/) and [construction companies](/sponsor-licence-construction/).

We can meet you at our office or come to your premises in Greater Manchester.

sections.heading: Travel visas and document legalisation
sections.text: Travelling from Manchester? We handle [visas and eVisas for countries worldwide](/worldwide-visas/), including India, Saudi Arabia, the USA and Schengen countries. We also arrange [apostilles and embassy legalisation](/document-legalisation/) for degree certificates, police checks and company documents. You can drop documents at our office instead of posting them.

sections.heading: Areas we cover
sections.text:
We help clients in Manchester city centre and across Greater Manchester, including Salford, Trafford, Stockport, Tameside, Oldham, Rochdale, Bury, Bolton and Wigan.

You don’t need to live nearby. We work with clients across the UK, and overseas, by phone, video call, email and WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Can I come to your Manchester office without an appointment?
faqs.a: Please call or email first. We’re a small team, and booking ahead makes sure an adviser is free to see you and has time to go through your documents properly.

faqs.q: Do I have to visit the office?
faqs.a: No. Many clients come in, but most cases can be handled by phone, video call, email and WhatsApp, wherever you live in the UK.
Yes. Unique Visa Services Ltd is regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority (IAA), reference F200700144. You can check our registration on the IAA’s public adviser finder.

faqs.q: Where is the Chinese visa centre in Manchester?
faqs.a: Since October 2026, the Chinese Visa Application Service Centre in Manchester has been at Ground Floor, 7 Charlotte Street, Manchester M1 4DZ. Check the centre’s own website before you go, as opening hours change around UK and Chinese holidays.

faqs.q: Do you help people outside Greater Manchester?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with clients all over the UK and overseas. Being based in Manchester simply means you can meet us in person if you’d like to.
